description.en: Derived self-check for changed files: parses PowerShell, JS/TS and JSON with the matching tool, finds the tests of the plugin or project each changed file belongs to and runs them, then reports a per-file verdict. Unrecognized extensions are recorded as skipped instead of silently passed, and a plugin source change with no tests at all fails.
description.zh: 按「本次改了什么」自动推导检查：用对应工具解析 PowerShell、JS/TS 和 JSON，找到改动文件所属插件或项目并运行它的测试，最后给出逐文件判定。不认识的扩展名记为跳过而不是静默通过；插件源码有改动却没有任何测试时直接判失败。
